newsitem.title: ITALY: POLL--Italy seen issuing 12.5 trln lire of BOTs.
newsitem.headline: POLL--Italy seen issuing 12.5 trln lire of BOTs.

text.p: The Italian Treasury is expected to issue between 11.500 and 13.500 trillion lire of short term bills (BOTs) at its next auction on August 11, with an average forecast of 12.500 trillion lire, analysts said on Tuesday.
There are some 14.500 trillion lire of BOTs maturing.

For zero coupon CTZ bills, the consensus forecast for the auction, also on August 11, is the issue of 1.500 trillion lire of 18-month paper and two trillion lire of 24-month paper. Some 9.100 trillion lire of CTZs mature at the end of August.
The payment for this paper is fixed for August 14 and the amounts will be announced by the Treasury on August 6.
